coaching.headline: A draft that lost every lane collapsed at the Outer Tower twice; we won zero fights all night.
coaching.team: Every one of our five lanes read unfavored before the first ward dropped, and the game played out that way: first blood went to The Fey on Steel at 3.7 in the duo lane, and the river went to them 13 times to our 2. We never won a skirmish outright all game -- zero fights won, two tied, five lost -- and Zarus did the damage: three of our four caught-out-alone deaths belonged to him. The 14.8 catch on Renna preceded both the Fangtooth and the first Outer Tower falling at 15.5. The 16.6 catch on Sparrow preceded the second Outer Tower at 17.5. The 17-minute fight that followed was opened a body down, 4 against 5, with Sparrow already dead; it was lost 1-3 and bought the enemy that second tower. Objective damage finished 3,078 to 10,150, towers 0 to 2.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Two solo catches by Zarus -- Renna at 14.8 and Sparrow at 16.6 -- cost both Outer Towers and forced the 17-minute fight 4 against 5, which we lost 1-3.
coaching.whatWorked: Sparrow was the one player who answered: 4 kills on 2 deaths, including picks on The Fey and GRIM.exe, on a build 2 of 3 core items deep.

perPlayer.643feff7-a6a5-4aae-8005-49c60d8b282a: Sparrow led the roster with 4 kills on 2 deaths, picking off The Fey, Zarus, GRIM.exe and Gadget, and finished closest to on-core: 2 of the 3 recommended items done, missing only Spectra. Both deaths were still costly -- the 16.6 solo catch by Zarus preceded the Outer Tower falling at 17.5.

focus.title: Stop walking into Zarus alone
focus.evidence: Three of our four caught-out-alone deaths this game belonged to Zarus -- Renna at 9.8 and 14.8, Sparrow at 16.6 -- and the two mid-game catches on Renna and Sparrow each preceded an Outer Tower falling (15.5, 17.5).
focus.action: Once Zarus hits his mid-game duel spike, rotate in pairs -- no one crosses the map alone until the next group fight.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel
